headline: Tapestry: A Better Business In A Better Industry (Rating Upgrade)
summary: Tapestry's valuation at 17x EV/EBITDA and 22x FY2026 EPS is justified by superior growth and margin expansion vs. peers. Read why TPR stock is upgraded to Buy.
